title: Signal: Possible a Redis connection URI with inline credentials assigned to REDIS_URI in source
scope: One line, matching a Redis connection URI with inline credentials assigned to REDIS_URI.
limitations: Shape-only: a URL-shaped literal with a user:password authority carrying 6+ password characters. It cannot prove the endpoint is reachable or the account is live.
fpNotes: Placeholder URLs such as postgres://user:password@localhost in documentation and compose samples are the common false positives; the rule requires 6+ password characters and vetoes EXAMPLE text.
